question.text: A Cat III AIF offers Class A1 (1.5% fee), A2 (2%), B1 (2%), C1 (2%). After one year, NAV differences BETWEEN Class A1 and others arise primarily due to:

answer.text: Differential management fee allocation in series calculations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.3, different management fees across classes drive Series NAV differences over time. The Trap: Redemption/FX/tax may contribute marginally but are not the primary cause. Cross-Exam Context: From Example 6. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Explain NAV drift to clients in 'higher-fee' classes — transparency improves trust.
